What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).

The default of `scrypt`: `sodium` on every target, whatever the program links (<<hash-default-backend>>).
